descriptionMarkdown: Hello everyone, I want to introduce my largest project on the Factorio - Vulcanus MALL. This mall produces 108 different items from ores. The full list of items is shown in the screenshot. The mall produces all components and you can use robots to expand production for your purposes Now this book of blueprints is not only about the mall, but will also contain all my blueprints about the Vulcanus #### **`Blueprint book contains:`** - 2 versions of the mall: 1. Basic MALL. It produces 77 items WITHOUT DRONES, only belts, only hardcore 2. Extended MALL already produces 108 items with minimal use of robots 3. Extended MALL with space production - 115 items -Other blueprints in the book: 1. Rocket factory. 2 rockets every minute to send all this stuff to the spaceship 2. Foundy - 14 per minute 3. Big mining drills - 30 per minute 4. Cliff explosives - 62 per minute 5. Vulcanus science - 100 SPM 6. Micro mall 7. Piercing rounds magazines and Demolisher Trap 8. Artillery Shells and SpaceShip for their transportation 9. Tungsten carbide and tungsten beams of all types of quality 10. All types of science from the planet Nauvis at 100 SPM (production is completely stable, but the external appearance is not yet fully formed) Useful information. The peak consumption of the extended MALL is 800 MW or about 300 MW during operation. Full filling of chests with resources is 2 hours for a regular mall and 4.5 hours for an extended one. The entire mall is calculated on a calculator, so each assembly machine, each beacon and module is in its place How to use it? Very simple! The type of incoming and outgoing resources is indicated on the display panels. All you need to do is to deliver resources to the underground belts and pipes. It is also necessary to remove the stone from the factory. That's it enjoy production This project took me a huge amount of time, major updates are planned in the future, so I will be very glad for your support, you can also check other bluepronts in my profile Upd 18.08.2025: 1. Now this book of blueprints is not only about the mall, but will also contain all my blueprints about the Vulcanus 2. Bugfix in Extended mall, thanks to the user "Obliviian" for finding the error 3. Bugfix related to liquid production, also increased production of lubricants and production of speed modules 4. Added Spaceship for artillery shells 5. Added Artillety factory 6. Bugfix with overflow roboports UPD 24.11.2025 1. New blueprints added 2. minor bugfix
